description: Change a share you made (or any share, if you're an admin): title, summary fields, who it's for, linked pull requests and issues, or visibility. Summary lists you pass replace the old ones; use add_next to append next steps and add_links to link more PRs or issues.

add_links.description: Pull requests or issues to link, besides the ones already linked

add_next.description: Next steps to append to the existing ones

id.description: Id of the session to change

people.description: Make it visible only to these people; an empty list makes it visible to the whole team

pr_url.description: The main pull request URL, or "none"

publish.description: Publish a draft (saved automatically at session end) to the team, or to `people`

name: update_session
title: Edit a shared session
